resolution: Compiled relief floors now carry their authored paint mask instead of collapsing to one averaged material. The bake writes a v2 heightfields lump containing the regular height grid plus a 4px-per-tile RGBA texture made from the chunk tileData palette; constructor.zig decodes and owns that texture; world_loader.zig registers the terrain heightfield for physics and binds the texture on the native Scene3D heightfield mesh. Verified with tools/rjit game verify and a fresh /compiled screenshot at zig-out/game/hmsc-int-compiled-painted-heightfield.png showing the black painted band on the terrain.
